title: T03c — Grader tamper protection; stale or mismatched evidence rejected; authority rechecked
goal: Grader tamper protection; stale or mismatched evidence rejected; authority rechecked.
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
acceptance: Grader tamper protection; stale or mismatched evidence rejected; authority rechecked
Versioned NERV cases include hidden immutable acceptance, deliberately flawed patches, false rejection and shared blind-spot cases
A combination result binds both configurations, handoffs, budgets, hosts and component evidence without averaging away safety failures
Record accepted task rate, escaped defects, repair rounds, reviewer effort, latency and total resource cost; missing metrics remain unknown
External runner owns coding isolation; no model self-approval, automatic qualification or grants
Candidate cannot modify the independent grader, hidden acceptance or grading credentials; tampering fails explicitly
Acceptance identifies the exact artifact and grader/configuration; promotion rejects stale or mismatched evidence and independently checks current NERV authorization
validation: Validate NERV pack/adapter across the Gauntlet evidence boundary with neutral fixtures
Run applicable scoped checks and required CI; live acceptance is separately recorded
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
Escalate repeated tool failures or inadequate context; no automatic cloud fallback

effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T03c of the step "NERV combination qualification pack and evidence adapter". Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 2.25 hours agent; former 1.5-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1.5 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 2.25 h → 1.25 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept. Estimate column backfilled 2026-11-12 at harness 7.0.0: estimateAgentHours = remaining plus actual so far (1.25 h); the baseline stays for calibration.
